mapper.select: SELECT bno, title, content, writer, regdate, updatedate, viewcnt, location, review_cnt, rating_avg FROM tbl_board ORDER BY bno DESC OFFSET #{pageStart} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{perPageNum} ROWS ONLY
SELECT count(*) FROM tbl_board WHERE bno > 0
mapper.insert:
select seq_board.nextval from dual
INSERT INTO tbl_board (bno, title, content, writer, location, regdate, updatedate) VALUES (#{bno}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{location}, sysdate, sysdate)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, location = #{location}, writer = #{writer}, updateDate = SYSDATE WHERE bno = #{bno}
UPDATE tbl_board SET viewcnt = viewcnt + 1 WHERE bno = #{bno}

UPDATE tbl_board b SET
review_cnt = (SELECT COUNT(rno) FROM tbl_review WHERE bno = b.bno),
rating_avg = (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) FROM tbl_review WHERE bno = b.bno)
WHERE b.bno = #{bno}
